chapter.verse: Topa in uk hi; leitung lungdam hen la, tuikulh neu tampite zong lungdam ta uh hen!
Meiipite leh khuamial sahpite ama kiim-ah om a, thumanna leh thutan’nate in ama tokhom’ bulpi ahi hi.
Ama mai-ah mei pai a, a kimkot-a om ama langpangte kangtum hi.
Ama khuaphialepte in leitung taang sak a, leitung in mu-in a liing hi.
Topa ’ mai, leitung mi khempeuh Topa ’ mai-ah mualliante in khuainun bangin tui suak uh hi.
Vantungte in ama thumanna genkhia a, mi khempeuhte in ama minthan’na en uh hi.
Bangmah man lo milimte a kisak theihpih, milim a bia mi khempeuhte maizumin kikoih a, ama mai-ah pasian khempeuh kun uh hi.
Pasian aw, Zion in za-in nuam a, nangma thukhennate hangin Judah khuapite lungdam uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa aw, leitung khempeuh a ukpa na hi a, pasian dang khempeuh sangin nakpi takin na lianzaw hi.
Topa in gitlohna a mudahte it a, amah in a mi siangthote’ nuntakna kem hi; amah in migilote khut sung panin amaute honkhia hi.
Thuman mite’ tungah khuavak hong taang a, lungsim thutang mite’ tungah lungdamna hong tung hi.
Thuman mite aw, Topa sungah lungdam un la, ama min siangtho phat un!
